rust_tests.reason: The new C overflow module (dev3-row-overflow.md#o2a-record) and the head-record encoder row_record::encode_overflow_record it calls: reserve_total (2,049..131,072, else Unsupported; C = 244), planned_record (head record with the anchor as the root placeholder), sealed_projection (root-free XRP1), reserve_job (@285 = 1, pending front 0/total/written 0), chunk_write (written < k, the sealed digest, payload window, allocator LSN, front Allocated(table, Overflow), no Reserved entry, lowest eligible Free), write_chunk (allocator entry, chunk INIT, LEAF scratch zeroed), forward_chain, clr_chain, entry_offset and their source models (the actor's Reserved-root and Retained-root checks before chunk_write are prepare.rs's ChunkWrite arm, group [1]). OVF-C01 runs the Reserve and the three ChunkWrites of a 40,018 B row (k = 3) against values recomputed from the contract integers W/F/R/X and the O1 codecs (no literal): Job cells, root-free projection, descriptor chain.apply, row 1, allocator entries, chunk cells, frame 56,976 B and redo order; Reserve totals 2,048 and 131,073 refused as Unsupported before output; the 12 ChunkWrite refusals before output (inline root, payload length, digest, Reserved entry, no eligible Free, allocator LSN, the three front violations, Retained root, all written, Cancel of a written root); the chunk-cell and allocator-entry observer mutants and the jobs.rs-only Job mutants. OVF-C02 runs Forward(overflow) with its 14 refusals, Commit/Prune, the full-rollback CLR (chain() = anchor 12, chunk 0 page 17, total; budget (5, 281,168)) and ReleaseRole of the chained root refused, while the inline root 16's ReleaseRole at the same state is accepted. The twins repeat the Reserve and ChunkWrites through produce_borrowed/observe_borrowed; ovf_c_head_record checks encode_overflow_record against encode_row_record_with_schema's Overflow arm byte for byte. The two let-else refusals on the change (place_chunk's ChunkWrite, forward_chain's ForwardOverflow) are defensive and reached by no case (prepare reaches place_chunk only for op ChunkWrite, the change's own operation, and forward_chain only after the ForwardOverflow pairing). ovf_c_census asserts chunk_write_bytes and source::leaf below prepare's callee maximum (the ledger term), write_chunk_bytes below the other write-step terms and forward_chain_bytes below the leaf term.

The shared C transition paths O2a changes. transition.rs: the ReserveOverflow/ChunkWrite/ForwardOverflow arms of Change::operation, refuse_unproduced and observe_with's inserted cell. prepare.rs: typed_leaf accepts an Overflow row, check_record compares the Job's sealed projection and returns the record's own, prepare_leaf's Forward/CLR/Prune (forward_chain, clr_chain, the payload Prune restamps), reserve_target's Overflow test, the Reserve planned/record/projection matches and reserve_job, the ChunkWrite arm, Cancel of a written root, the ForwardOverflow pairing, the CLR budget branch, the ReleaseRole/RootFree chain refusal, write_pages' ChunkWrite return and the callee/write source maxima. frame.rs: native kinds 6/10/12, the allocator-entry and chunk-header native ranges, the redo target/prior refactor and Patch versus INIT. The four overflow cases reach every overflow arm (Cancel of a written root InvalidInput in OVF-C01; ForwardOverflow pairing, the overflow CLR budget and ReleaseRole with a chain InvalidInput in OVF-C02; kinds 6/12 and the INIT in every ChunkWrite). The N1, S1-A/D/G, MCA-04, RDL-C and RUP-C cases run inline INSERT/DELETE/UPDATE groups through the same changed lines (the inline arms, the CLR (4, 4R) budget, the default native range and Patch) and the N1/RDL-C/RUP-C histories compare the produced frames with the fixed literals byte for byte, so inline output is unchanged; N1's source bound reads callee_bytes/write_source_bytes with the new chunk_write and write_chunk terms. transition_tests.rs's World changes run with them: the allocator/chunk fields every World builds, cross_check skipping status.rs/undo.rs for ChunkWrite and install of the allocator/chunk images in every produced or observed group, the ReserveOverflow plan in the overflow cases. Reached by no selected case: reserve_target's Overflow refusal (big-row DELETE/UPDATE, 08-4), check_record's payload-kind mismatch arm, Prune's Deleted arm and native kind 10 (TreeAnchor; no O2a group has an anchor native), and frame.rs's two defensive INIT length checks (written or compared length != the encoded length).

jobs.rs: the ReservePlan.overflow pending start value, the ChunkWrite arm (pending front moves, written + 1, total kept, only [328,360) and [376,384) change), the overflow CLR/Prune rule (chain anchor = pair[0]; Prune leaves no overflow), ReleaseRole only without a chain, ChunkWrite in the statement and leased-census lists and census reserved == 1; jobs_tests.rs only adds overflow: None to its plan() helper. OVF-C01 reaches the ChunkWrite arm and census in every ChunkWrite and its jobs.rs-only Job mutants (written + 2, front kept, total changed, each resealed) are refused by this rule alone; OVF-C02 passes the overflow CLR anchor and Prune rules (accepting side). The jobs_tests cases reach the changed lines for inline roots (pending None at Reserve, the overflow check skipped, chain None at ReleaseRole, the statement/census lists) and their pairs and mutants are unchanged. Reached by no case (deleted, the 71 cases selected before MCA00-V06 still pass; MCA00-V06 runs only inline Forward/CLR and reaches none of the overflow refusals): ChunkWrite's no-pending IdentityMismatch, the Reserve pending compare's refusal, ChunkWrite in the statement/mutation list, census reserved == 1, the overflow CLR anchor and Prune refusals, and ReleaseRole's chain conjunct. Two are implied before jobs.rs's rule: the Job codec refuses @285 = 1 outside Reserved/Retained/ReleasingCompensated (Corrupt, so no Prune after keeps it; OVF-F02 checks ReleasingCommitted), and a ReleaseRole after that keeps the chain at cursor 1 does not decode while one that clears it fails unchanged. The other five are seen in this stage only by the whole-group observer (the same prepare). Of the tests that call jobs::observe (jobs_tests, transition_tests' World, transition_overflow_tests, row/insert/group_tests) only transition_overflow_tests feeds it an overflow Job (job_tests and ledger_tests build such Jobs without jobs.rs), so no wider selection reaches them.

leaf.rs: the projection match on (payload, Job overflow) with root_free_projection for an overflow root, sealed_value ((total, digest) of the head or the inline canonical length and SHA-256), Prune's payload equality replacing the inline compare, and validate_rows' three-arm match. The leaf_tests cases reach the inline arms (Forward seal and projection, Prune restamp and its payload mutants, validate_rows over every neighbor); OVF-C02's Forward and Prune of the overflow root reach the overflow arms (root-free projection, (total, digest), the head kept at Prune). validate_rows' Deleted arm (moved into the match, body unchanged) is reached only by group [1]'s RDL-C and RUP-C histories (cross_check's leaf.rs). The payload-kind refusals ((Overflow, inline Job), (inline, overflow Job)) are reached by no case: leaf.rs binds the Job to the frame through undo.rs first, so such an input needs a consistently rebuilt frame Job native (dev3-row-overflow.md#o2a-record, moved to O2c).

undo.rs: U's before pageLSN must be >= lease_lsn for Forward and >= last_step for the other roles. For an inline root last_step = lease_lsn, so the undo_tests pairs and mutants that reach the rule (Forward, CLR, Prune and release steps) are unchanged; OVF-C02's Forward follows three ChunkWrites (last_step > lease_lsn, U still at the Reserve LSN) and passes undo.rs, which the old >= last_step rule refuses. The exact == lease_lsn check after it is unchanged. MCA00-V06 runs A's produced Forward and CLR frames through the C observers and so through the changed rule from the A side.

ledger.rs: Reserved root row 1 = debt(forward_steps, forward_wal) with undo_slots 1, and the Reserved root rule descriptor.chain.apply == last_step. For an inline root forward_steps = 1 and last_step = lease_lsn, so the ledger literal/state cases (RDL-F09 and RUP-F07 rows, descriptor identity/order mutants, budget and statement credit, observation scope) show both rules unchanged. OVF-C01 checks the ATT descriptor C writes after the Reserve and after each ChunkWrite: row 1 = (1 + left, left*W + F) for the left unwritten chunks (remaining()), and chain.apply = that group's LSN = the Job's last_step, which validate_transaction's Reserved-root rule accepts in the cross-checked observation; the old debt(1, ..) row 1 differs from the Reserve on ((4, 262,604) for k = 3 in OVF-C01's reserve()), and the old chain.apply == lease_lsn rule from the first ChunkWrite's after check on.

transition/source.rs: source::leaf gains check_record's table and projections and the head/Prune payload/root-zero terms and takes the max with forward_chain_bytes and clr_chain_bytes; ledger_remaining adds row 1's two Job reads. Both feed prepare::callee_bytes/write_source_bytes (with chunk_write_bytes/write_chunk_bytes) and so transition::source_bytes, produce/observe_borrowed_source_bytes and ledger_source_bytes. N1 and S1-A/S1-D check those bounds against the measured frames (the only existing census output line that changes is N1_SOURCE_TERMS leaf 9,924 -> 10,300, per §15 and D2 r1/r2; the N1 bound 30,359 is unchanged); ovf_c_census keeps the new terms below the maxima. The S2W C01-C04/C06, F4-C Begin, live Row retirement and UNL-A03 cases read the borrowed bounds through the Row phase bodies (row_reserve_body, row_forward_body, row_cancel_body, row_group_terms) and the live/recovery source censuses and assert their margins, Row lifecycle <= charge, C charge 44,304 and the live/recovered peaks unchanged. S2W-C05 reads none of these terms and is not selected.
